images.filename: Phra Pathom Chedi Thailand.JPG
images.caption: The Great Pagoda in Nakhon Pathom, Thailand, the Phra Pathom Chedi (พระปฐมเจดีย์), is believed to be the tallest Buddhist monument in the world. Its origins date back to ancient times, but the present monument was rebuilt in the 19th century by King Mongkut and finished in 1870.
images.alt: The Great Pagoda in Nakhon Pathom, Thailand, the Phra Pathom Chedi (พระปฐมเจดีย์), is believed to be the tallest Buddhist monument in the world. Its origins date back to ancient times, but the present monument was rebuilt in the 19th century by King Mongkut and finished in 1870.
